aggregationPolicy: Report each Model×Harness cell across the three blocked task families; preserve task-level rows. Do not count repeated reads, verifier assertions, or Provider turns as independent replicates.
construct: Total Provider token usage reported by the Harness run.
knownLimitations: Pilot has three deterministic task blocks and one live run per Model×Harness×task cell; cell effects are descriptive and do not establish broad model or Harness superiority.
nonClaims: Metric does not establish Provider, Runtime, Harness, Git, or domain authority.
